title: Human Values in a Single Sentence: Moral Presence, Hierarchies, and Transformer Ensembles on the Schwartz Continuum
findings: The paper does not analyze or report findings related to religion or faith. The focus is on the detection of secular, psychological-based human values in text.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the presence of 19 human values from the Schwartz motivational continuum (a psychological theory) in single sentences from news and political manifestos. This includes values like 'Tradition', 'Benevolence', and 'Security'. The study does not measure any aspects specifically related to religion or faith; its framework is secular.
